items.title: Singapore to Ensure AI Helps Workers Worried About Jobs, PM Says
items.author: Shamim Adam and Philip J. Heijmans
items.content: <article>Singapore is benefitting from the rapid growth of artificial intelligence and the government is making use of the technology to ensure higher productivity and better jobs for workers who are worried about their livelihoods, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said.</article>

items.title: Data Center Firm Switch to File Confidentially for IPO
items.author: Bailey Lipschultz
items.content: <article>Switch Inc. filed confidentially for a US IPO, according to people familiar with the matter, joining its data center peers in tapping demand for exposure to the artificial intelligence theme.</article>

items.title: PGA Tour CEO Exclusive and David Kelly Talks Investing | Bloomberg Money 8/7/2026
items.content: <article>Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: Meredith Whitney Advisory Group CEO Meredith Whitney, JPMorgan Asset Management Chief Global Strategist David Kelly, and PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Spelman President on Federal Funding, AI Popularity
items.content: <article>Spelman College President, Dr. Ayanna Howard, sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss the impact of federal funding rollbacks for HBCUs, and the impact of AI on college graduates. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Akamai CEO on Earnings, Cloud Industry, New Investment
items.content: <article>Akamai's shares declined following the release of its second-quarter earnings report, despite the company beating earnings estimates. Tom Leighton, Co-Founder and CEO of Akamai, joined the program to discuss the company's performance and recent developments. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: SoftBank-Backed 3D Printer Maker Formlabs Said to Weigh IPO
items.author: Bailey Lipschultz
items.content: <article>Formlabs, a maker of 3D printers, is in early talks with potential advisers for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.</article>

items.title: Gen CEO on Earnings, New Cybersecurity Attack Tracker
items.content: <article>Gen Digital's shares are reaching their highest levels in nearly a year following an upward revision of its earnings forecast. Vincent Pilette, President and CEO of Gen Digital, expressed strong confidence in sustaining double-digit growth over the coming quarters, driven by increased demand for cybersecurity solutions amid growing concerns related to AI and agentic technologies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: JPMorgan Boosts Tech Bond Sales Outlook as AI Debt Binge Expands
items.author: Charlotte Plaskwa
items.content: <article>JPMorgan Chase & Co. sees bond sales from technology-related firms exceeding half a trillion dollars this year, as hyperscalers’ appetite to deploy capital for the artificial intelligence buildout shows no sign of abating despite growing investor fatigue.</article>

items.title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchanges As Talks Continue
items.author: Magdalena Del Valle
items.content: <article>The US ramped up economic pressure on Iran with more sanctions targeting digital asset exchanges and networks connected to the country’s shadow-banking system, as Washington seeks leverage amid ongoing negotiations over the war.</article>

items.title: Jobs Shock Sends Stocks Higher | Open Interest 8/7/2026
items.content: <article>Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Stocks rise after data showed US employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July. Meanwhile, oil wavers as prospects for a lasting agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remain elusive. National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett, BlackRock’s Rick Rieder and Julia Coronado of MacroPolicy Perspectives react to the surprising jobs report and what it means for the economy and Fed policy. Tanger CEO Stephen Yalof offers a read on the consumer. Plus, Ethan Allen Chairman & CEO Farooq Kathwari responds to an activist campaign seeking to replace the company’s entire board. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: OpenAI Pauses Some Work on New Astra Model on Cyber Concerns
items.author: Seth Fiegerman
items.content: <article>OpenAI is pausing some internal work around one of its upcoming artificial intelligence models to implement stricter safeguards after the system was found to be significantly more adept at cybersecurity tasks.</article>

items.title: SK Hynix Said to Mull Options for $3 Billion Chongqing Plant
items.author: Pei Li and Dong Cao
items.content: <article>South Korea’s SK Hynix Inc. is considering options for its Chongqing, China-based facility, including bringing in an investor to help accelerate growth, according to people with knowledge of the matter.</article>

items.title: CAIS CEO Talks New Funding Round, AI’s Fintech Impact
items.content: <article>Matt Brown, Founder, Chairman, and CEO of CAIS, discussed the company's recent $170 million Series D funding round led by Vista and supported by AllianzBernstein, Blue Owl, and Carlyle, which values the alternative asset investment platform at over $2 billion—more than double its previous valuation. Brown highlighted CAIS's 37% organic growth and explained that the new capital will be used to pursue strategic mergers and acquisitions in response to ongoing fintech industry consolidation, enhance AI capabilities to improve the platform's user experience for advisers and asset managers, and provide liquidity to long-term shareholders through an institutional tender offer facilitated by Nasdaq Private Markets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)</article>
